subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https markdown image URLs directly from chat content, proxy them through a same-origin controlled media path, or keep the current same-origin/data/blob-only image policy?
rationale: Current source, tests, docs, and CSP intentionally prevent arbitrary remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX change would relax that security/privacy boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote default
options.body: Preserve the current same-origin/data/blob policy and require structured same-origin media, a proxy, or explicit opt-in design before remote images render.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the browser-fetch privacy tradeoff and update renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and browser/network proof together.

options.title: Design a proxy or broader media policy
options.body: Use a controlled same-origin proxy or the broader inline-media work to handle remote image previews without direct arbitrary browser fetches.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current same-origin/data/blob policy and require structured same-origin media, a proxy, or explicit opt-in design before remote images render.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy changed in PR 69773.
